product_metadata.title: Fantes Champagne Stopper, Made in Italy, The Italian Market Original since 1906
features: Fantes Aunt Vittorina’s Champagne Stopper reseals opened bottles of champagne to preserve freshness longer
Flip top with silicone seal makes serving from opened bottles easy, then re-seals to keep contents fresh
Sturdy, slide-on design is easy to attach to bottlenecks; compact for easy storage
Made in Italy by Ghidini, Europe’s premier corkscrew manufacturer
Wipe with a clean, damp cloth
description: Fantes Aunt Vittorina’s Champagne Stoppers unique design and silicone seal locks in bubbles to preserve champagne’s freshness longer and keep it from going flat too quickly. No more struggling with bloated bottle corks to reseal an opened champagne bottle. Simply pop champagne bottles open and serve, then slide Aunt Vittorina’s Champagne Stopper onto the bottle’s neck and close the bottle stopper lid to seal in freshness. Flip the top to pour the next glass of bubbly without removing the stopper from the bottle. Compact for easy storage. Made in Italy by Ghidini, Europe’s premier corkscrew manufacturer. Wipe with a clean, damp cloth. Fante’s, The Italian Market Original since 1906. Brought to you by HIC Harold Import Co.
